name: @gjsify/webview2-native
description: Microsoft's WebView2 (Chromium) behind a GObject API shaped like WebKitGTK 6.0 — the win32 backend for @gjsify/iframe (ADR 0035). Deliberately claims the WebKit-6.0 namespace; the engine is Chromium. Contains no JavaScript; the prebuilt library and typelib arrive through per-target optionalDependencies.

osNotes.linux: Binds Microsoft's WebView2, which exists only on Windows. Linux has the real thing: @gjsify/iframe imports gi://WebKit 6.0 there and never reaches this package. The Linux build of this library exists only so g-ir-scanner can produce WebKit-6.0.gir, and it is never staged or shipped.
osNotes.darwin: Binds Microsoft's WebView2, which exists only on Windows. macOS is served by @gjsify/webkit-native, which claims the same namespace with Apple's WebKit behind it (ADR 0022).

scripts.build:meson: gjsify run init:meson && meson compile -C build
scripts.test: echo 'covered by the win32 leg of prebuilds.yml'
